title: Onboard Astrid-13B v1.0: perf profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: Add Astrid-13B v1.0 to the model registry with production-ready metadata and validated performance profiles, and wire it into the changelog/release-notes automation so product and release teams get consistent entries.

Summary: This PR adds model metadata (config pointers, tokenizer, weights manifest), multiple perf profiles produced by the perf lab (low-latency, high-throughput), validation tests for the registry schema, CI perf job integration, and an entry in the changelog-generator mapping so the release pipeline emits an initial release note for Astrid v1.0.

Checklist: [x] Model metadata JSON (id, architecture, tokenizer, repo, license) added; [x] Perf profiles for common hardware targets (A100-80GB, H100, T4) added and validated; [x] Automated changelog mapping updated to generate release notes on model onboarding; [x] Unit tests for metadata schema and perf profile schema added; [x] CI perf job added (dry-run) and green; [x] Docs updated with onboarding notes and caveats.

Notes: Performance profiles were generated from the perf-lab runs dated 2026-01-18 and include median p50/p95 latencies, token throughput at recommended batch sizes, and memory footprints. The changelog entry is produced via the existing changelog-generator; this PR also adds a small mapping so model maintainers can provide a short human-friendly blurb that surfaces in the release notes. No breaking changes to existing APIs or registry format are introduced.
commits: Add Astrid-13B v1.0 metadata and model manifest
Add perf profiles: A100/H100/T4 resource + latency/throughput entries
Changelog automation: register astrid-13b -> release note template
Tests: metadata and perf profile schema validation
CI: add perf benchmark job and gating config
Docs: onboarding guide update and quickstart example
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Please include the tokenizer commit hash and confirm license compatibility — we should not ship unclear licenses.

Sofia Ramirez: Perf numbers look good. Can you add p99 for the high-throughput profile and a note about KV-cache behavior for long-context workloads?
Maya Patel: Added p99 and a short note in perf_profiles.yaml describing observed KV-cache pressure on >4k contexts and recommended config (cache_shards=4, kv_prefetch=true).
Chen Li: Tests look fine. One nit: update the changelog template to include model size (13B) so PMs can surface it in the UI.
Maya Patel: Updated registry_mapping.csv and regenerated the changelog preview. CI showed a transient lint failure; reran and all checks passed.
Liam O'Connor: Approved-by: l.oconnor — verified license & perf summaries.
release_notes:
- Onboarded Astrid-13B v1.0 to the model registry with validated performance profiles for A100/H100/T4.
- Automated changelog mapping added so Astrid v1.0 appears in release notes with a short human-friendly blurb.
- Added metadata validation tests and CI perf job (dry-run).
notes_for_ops: Recommend scheduling a small canary rollout on Dedicated to validate autoscaling behavior for the high-throughput profile; see perf_profiles.yaml for recommended batch sizes and memory footprints.
